comment_regular: [Verified] BSTempEffectDecal_LoadGame allocates a 0x4C DECAL_DATA payload, reloads its source texture into +0, restores transform/vector/reference fields, resolves a NiProperty* at +0x48 from the saved geometry/property index, then calls BSShaderLightingProperty_AddDecalData on that property. This is the save-load re-registration path.
